title: List the getters
description:
Write `class Inspect` with `static List<String> getters(Class<?> type)` returning the names of the type's **public** methods that are getters, sorted alphabetically. A getter:

- takes no parameters,
- does not return `void`,
- is named `getX...` (with at least one character after `get`) or, if it returns `boolean`, `isX...`,
- is not `getClass` (which every object inherits).
hints: `type.getMethods()` gives the public methods, inherited ones included. `m.getParameterCount()`, `m.getReturnType()` and `m.getName()` answer the three questions.
